payload.core_mechanism_summary: For each student i, greedily keep as many previous students as possible with smallest times first to maximize number of non-failures within time M - t_i.
payload.rationale: The solution uses a frequency array over t_j (1..100) and scans in increasing order to accumulate total time, keeping all of a given time if it fits, else keeping as many as possible; this corresponds to greedy selection by sorted time.
